title.en: Jurong Town Corporation (Assignment of Functions) Notification 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Jurong Town Corporation (Assignment of Functions) Notification 2018 and is deemed to have come into operation on 1 August 2016.

2. In this Notification, “public agency” means a body that is —
(a)established or constituted by or under a public Act to perform or discharge a public function; and
(b)nominated by the Government.
